note: 0.2.4 combat skills. Weapon class (items.json gear.class) decides the skill needed to wield it, the default style and the swing speed. Armour (head/body/legs/shield) needs Defence. Accuracy = 0.55 + (Attack + gear atk) x 1% - enemy defence x (1 - armour_break) x 2% (10-95%). Max hit = 1 + Strength/6 + weapon power + gear str/4. Enemy accuracy = base - (gear def x 1% + Defence x defence_level_acc) (5-95%).
note_damage_mult: 0.3.18 every landed hit (player, enemies, NPCs, AI, PvP) is scaled at the final step; a hit never drops below 1
note_armour_hit_xp: 0.3.18 bonus Defence XP per worn armour piece each time the player is hit, by gear tier (1 bronze/leather, 2 iron, 3 steel, 4 dusk; higher tiers +step each)
note_combat_level: 0.3.3 combat level (Combat.combat_level) = floor((Attack + Strength + Defence + Vitality + Archery) / 5 + Prayer / 8), min 1; a new character is Combat 2. Enemies never START a fight with anyone aggro_level_gap+ combat levels above the enemy's level.

ranged.note: 0.3.3 Archery. Bows shoot from up to range tiles (Chebyshev) with line of sight: wall/building tiles block, plants, rocks and fences don't. Each shot uses one *_arrows item (best usable tier); none = 'Out of arrows!' and the attack stops. Accuracy = 0.55 + (Archery + gear atk) x 1% - enemy def x 2%. Max hit = 1 + Archery/6 + bow power + gear str/4 + arrow tier x arrow_tier_power. arrow_drop_chance = arrows that land under the target (pick them up again). XP: damage_xp per damage to Archery + vitality_xp to Vitality.
